sm_kid.instruct: A 10-year-old American boy, bright clear childish voice, curious and playful, natural, close to the microphone.
sm_kid.ref: Wait, what? Who sent this? Is this a joke?

sm_old.instruct: An 80-year-old American man, warm gentle raspy voice, slow, kind grandfatherly tone, a soft smile in the voice.
sm_old.ref: Well, look at that. It has been a long, long time.

lines.emo: Puzzled, reading a strange note slowly, the end is a confused question.
Shouting happily out of a window, excited.
Reading a note aloud slowly, amused and touched.
One tiny soft breath of a laugh, then tender and short.
Tender, nostalgic, slow, a little emotional, like advice to a grandchild.
